label: MikroTik Wireless Wire Cube Pro
description: Preconfigured 60 GHz link kit: two Cube 60Pro ac units, each with one gigabit port, an 802.11ay 60 GHz radio and a 5 GHz 802.11ac radio.
notes: Vendor figures from the MikroTik product page specification table: the kit is two Cube 60Pro ac devices; wireless 5 GHz max data rate 433 Mbit/s (802.11a/n/ac) and the 60 GHz radio runs 802.11ay. The 60 GHz radio (radio1) is modelled at 1G - the wired port's rate - because the specification table states the standard but not a single maximum rate for that radio; treat that figure as unconfirmed and the 433 Mbit/s 5 GHz figure as quoted.
